summary: The new favorites block is owner-only, schema-validated on create and update, and emulator-tested. The overall inherited production rules retain a pre-existing critical entitlement boundary issue; this narrow provider-list fix does not certify or rewrite unrelated rules.

findings.issue: Inherited production rules allow users unrestricted writes to their own profile and payment documents, including entitlement fields. This existed before the favorites fix; the broader local hardening rules have not been rolled out.
findings.recommendation: Reconcile the broader local hardening rules with production admin and collection workflows, then deploy with regression tests as a separate security change.

findings.issue: Missing favorites permissions made the signed-in providers query fail. Fixed with owner-scoped list/read/delete and strict create/update validation.
findings.recommendation: Retain the emulator regression tests and reconcile this fix before future default rules deployments.
